items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: And Paul Morales was there, you know, his band, New Orleans, Little King.

ctx.x: Well, I never did know whether she could have been married then as far as I knew. Yeah. But Joe had several women pianists. It seemed like there was more women pianists who played that type of music than the men. Now there was a pianist up there from here called Arthur Campbell too. He played with George Field in the spot. And later on, fellas like Tom Aladdin came up and Mutt was up there for a while. And they came up, I think Mary Mack, like Mary Mack had, they played at the Monogram Theater. And so they began…
Did you ever see Big Jim Coliseum around?
